source_text: In Ethiopia, where Orthodox Christianity predominates, FGM rates among Christians mirrored national averages of 74% as of 2016 surveys, with some clergy historically tolerating Type I or II procedures as customary rites of passage tied to biblical covenants, but the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church has since 2013 rung church bells in campaigns against it, issuing declarations that it violates Christ's emphasis on wholeness in Mark 7:18-19. [27]
